system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:39:51 UTC, WS-MLOPEZ-01 requested the PowerShell script URL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/harbor-dental-it/tools/main/u.ps1 through the proxy; the request had no reported user agent.

A second connection from WS-MLOPEZ-01 to raw.githubusercontent.com followed at 13:39:52 UTC, with a Chrome 119 user agent and about 52 KB received. The records do not establish that this connection transferred the named script.
At 13:37 UTC, Maria's workstation accessed drive.google.com, an unapproved cloud-storage service in the supplied inventory. The records show page access, not an upload or download.

At 13:40:53 UTC, WS-MLOPEZ-01 established an SMB connection to DC-HD-01, and the domain controller recorded a network logon for the workstation's machine account. This occurred shortly after the script URL request, but the evidence does not establish a causal link.
The script retrieval and unapproved cloud-service access warrant investigation, but the available records do not establish that either activity was malicious.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor coverage reports a winsec and Sysmon collection outage for WS-MLOPEZ-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC. This covers the reported PowerShell-window time and the script request, so endpoint process creation and related Windows events cannot be assessed for that interval.
Proxy and Zeek connection records show network activity but do not reveal the contents of the script or prove execution.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell ran, what command line or parent process it had, or whether it caused the reported window to appear.
The contents, hash, legitimacy, or execution status of u.ps1.
Whether the SMB connection accessed a share or performed an administrative action, and what data or resources it involved.
Whether any files were uploaded to or downloaded from Google Drive.
Whether the observed activity was initiated by Maria, another user, or an automated process.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover endpoint telemetry for WS-MLOPEZ-01 during 13:30–14:10 UTC, including process creation, PowerShell operational/script-block logs, and any available console or command history.
Obtain the exact u.ps1 contents and hash, and validate the repository, commit, and whether this retrieval was authorized.
Review DC-HD-01 SMB server/share-access logs for the 13:40:53 UTC connection and determine the share and operations involved.
Review browser history and relevant file artifacts to determine whether Google Drive transfers occurred.
